title: Structural and Representational Agency in LLM-Driven Timbre Generation and Interpolation
abstract: arXiv:2610.12532v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative creative interfaces routinely report the user's position within a space of possibilities. Such displays imply that the quantities shown were measured from the artefact; in a growing class of systems they are instead predicted by a language model describing its own output, and the two are indistinguishable on screen. Most creative domains lack an agreed measurement against which such a self-report can be checked; audio admits one. In a measurement study of a working LLM-driven timbre interface, what a user can cause proves separable from what the interface reports. The first is exactly characterisable: the reachable set is a zonotope whose dimension increases by one per sound placed, so the space the model may act within is demonstrably the user's own. The second is inaccurate. The displayed position differs from measurement by approximately three times the width of that region, and the error has two independent sources: mode

translated_title: 大语言模型驱动的音色生成与插值中的结构能动性与表征能动性
translated_abstract: 生成式创意界面通常会报告用户在可能性空间中所处的位置。这类显示暗示所展示的量值是从作品本身测量得到的；但在越来越多的系统中，这些量值实际上是由一个描述其自身输出的语言模型预测出来的，而两者在屏幕上无法区分。大多数创意领域缺乏公认的测量标准来检验这种自我报告；而音频领域恰好存在这样的标准。在一项针对实际运行的大语言模型驱动音色界面的测量研究中，用户所能实际产生的效果被证明与界面所报告的内容是可分离的。前者可以被精确刻画：可达集是一个zonotope（区域多胞体），每放置一个声音其维度增加一，因此模型可以在其中行动的空间显然属于用户自身。后者则不准确：显示的位置与实际测量值相差约为该区域宽度的三倍，且该误差有两个独立的来源：模……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 本研究通过对一个实际运行的LLM驱动音色界面进行测量，首次证明用户真实可控的声音空间（可精确刻画为维度随放置声音数递增的zonotope）与界面中由语言模型自我报告的位置（误差约为该空间宽度的三倍）是可分离的，揭示了LLM创意界面中“实际能动性”与“表征能动性”之间的脱节。
en_tdlr: Through a measurement study of a working LLM-driven timbre interface, this paper shows that the user's actual agency—an exactly characterizable zonotope whose dimension grows by one with each sound placed—is separable from the interface's self-reported position, which is inaccurate by roughly three times the width of that region.
